text: The axiom 5 (◇φ → □◇φ) corresponds to reflexivity of the accessibility relation.
explanation: False: axiom 5 corresponds to the Euclidean property (wRv ∧ wRu ⇒ vRu), not reflexivity. Reflexivity is the frame condition for axiom T (□φ → φ). Confusing these two is a common frame-correspondence error.
